observation.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && echo "=== resolve ldap in web ==="; ddev exec sh -c "getent hosts ldap; echo ---; getent hosts openldap; echo ---; cat /etc/hosts"; echo "=== port 10389 check ==="; ddev exec sh -c "echo | timeout 3 bash -c \"cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/ldap/10389\" 2>&1 && echo 10389-OPEN || echo 10389-CLOSED"; echo "=== port 389 check ==="; ddev exec sh -c "echo | timeout 3 bash -c \"cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/ldap/389\" 2>&1 && echo 389-OPEN || echo 389-CLOSED"; ddev exec sh -c "echo | timeout 3 bash -c \"cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/openldap/389\" 2>&1 && echo openldap389-OPEN || echo openldap389-CLOSED"'
